body: Qantas has sold 44 Boeing 737 Next Generation aircraft to aftermarket specialist AerFin as part of plans to retire its workhorse fleet. AerFin confirmed on November 4, 2026 that the landmark acquisition includes 88 CFM International CFM56-7B engines, and said it is the largest transaction in the company's history. The entire transfer is expected to spread over seven years, with the first aircraft expected to leave Qantas later this year.

Qantas Domestic chief executive Markus Svensson said the airline's 737s will continue to fly "for many years, alongside our growing fleet of next generation aircraft". He said the agreement lets Qantas plan for the retirement of the majority of its 737 fleet while keeping flexibility to adjust the timing as new aircraft arrive, and that the airline expects to take delivery of up to 24 new aircraft this year. Qantas has so far received seven Airbus A321XLRs and is awaiting delivery of 41 more, according to ch-aviation data, and the A321XLRs are set to replace the Boeing 737s.

UK-based AerFin said the retired aircraft will be used to support airlines and MRO customers globally, providing access to aircraft material and tailored aftermarket solutions. "Transactions of this size require deep technical expertise, strong financial capability and trusted partnerships," AerFin chief executive Simon Goodson said.
en.summary: Qantas has sold 44 Boeing 737NGs, including 88 CFM56-7B engines, to AerFin in the aftermarket specialist's largest deal, with the transfer spread over seven years as A321XLRs replace the 737 fleet.
en.title: Qantas sells 44 Boeing 737NGs to AerFin as it plans retirement of its workhorse fleet

body: 澳洲航空已將44架波音737NG出售給航材售後專家AerFin，作為退役主力機隊計畫的一部分。AerFin於2026年11月4日確認，這筆具指標意義的收購包含88具CFM國際CFM56-7B發動機，並稱其為公司史上最大交易。整批移交預計歷時七年，首架飛機預計於今年稍晚離開澳航。
澳航國內線執行長Markus Svensson表示，澳航的737還會再飛很多年，與日益壯大的新世代機隊並肩同行。他說，這項協議讓澳航得以規劃多數737機隊的退役，同時保留隨新機交付調整時程的彈性，澳航預計今年接收最多24架新飛機。據ch-aviation資料，澳航迄今已接收7架空中巴士A321XLR，另有41架待交付，A321XLR將取代波音737。
總部位於英國的AerFin表示，退役飛機將用於支援全球航空公司與維修客戶，提供飛機物料與客製化售後解決方案。AerFin執行長Simon Goodson表示，如此規模的交易需要深厚的技術專長、強大的財務能力與值得信賴的合作夥伴關係。
zh.summary: 澳航將44架波音737NG售予AerFin，包含88具CFM56-7B發動機，創下AerFin史上最大交易；移交將歷時七年，A321XLR將接替退役的737機隊。
zh.title: 澳航出售44架737NG予AerFin，為退役主力機隊鋪路
